name: pipeline_reproducible
template: The entire 7-episode pipeline reproduces deterministically from raw archives to evaluation outputs and prediction records with identical SHA-256 baselines across all platforms.

name: preregistered_verdict
template: The pre-registered primary hypothesis test verdict is '{verdict}': pooled Markov Hit@3 ({markov_hit3:.2%}) does not exceed Frequency baseline Hit@3 ({freq_hit3:.2%}) at the primary technique level (Holm-adjusted p = {holm_p:.4f}).

name: p2_baseline_superiority
template: At the technique level (collapsed_full, N=95), the Frequency baseline (Hit@3 = {freq_hit3:.2%}) significantly outperforms the first-order Markov model (Hit@3 = {markov_hit3:.2%}, paired McNemar p = {mcnemar_p:.4f}).

name: p3_tactic_order_signal
template: At the tactic level (tactic_collapsed, N=76), attack sequence temporal order carries detectable signal against shuffled-order null S1 (Markov Hit@1 p = {s1_tactic_hit1_p:.4f}, Hit@3 p = {s1_tactic_hit3_p:.4f}).

name: p4_technique_no_order_signal
template: At the technique level (collapsed_full, N=95), attack sequence temporal order carries no detectable signal against shuffled-order null S1 (Markov Hit@1 p = {s1_tech_hit1_p:.4f}, Hit@3 p = {s1_tech_hit3_p:.4f}).

name: ceiling_and_cap_bounds
template: Cross-scenario vocabulary isolation restricts technique-level LOEO performance: target reachability ceiling is {ceiling_pct:.2f}% ({ceiling_num}/{ceiling_den}) and perfect-order prediction cap is {perfect_cap_pct:.2f}%, both strictly below 75%.

name: learning_curve_behavior
template: In combinatorial subset cross-validation (441 evaluations across k=1..6), Frequency baseline exceeds or matches Markov model in episode-mean tactic Hit@3 at every training subset size k.

name: tactic_hit1_tie_sensitivity
template: Under systematic tie-breaking evaluation (min, max, random over 1000 trials), tactic Hit@1 spans [{m_min:.2%}, {m_max:.2%}] for Markov and [{f_min:.2%}, {f_max:.2%}] for Frequency baseline, confirming stability of conclusions.

name: exploratory_variant_posthoc
template: The exploratory tactic-conditioned technique prediction variant (POST HOC, Amendment 7) achieves pooled Top-1 = {top1:.2%} and Top-3 = {top3:.2%} (descriptive McNemar vs Frequency p = {mcnemar_p:.4f}), which does not overturn the pre-registered verdict.

name: nfr1_timing_performance
template: End-to-end pipeline execution meets declared NFR1 timing criteria: warm median per episode is {warm_median:.4f} s (<= 2.0 s), p95 is {warm_p95:.4f} s (<= 5.0 s), and cold start is {cold_start:.4f} s (<= 10.0 s).

name: nfr2_determinism
template: Prediction record generation is 100% deterministic (NFR2): building all 171 records across 3 independent processes with PYTHONHASHSEED=0, 1, and 4242 produces identical SHA-256 JSONL digests.

name: nfr3_non_modification
template: Pipeline non-modification guarantee holds (NFR3): input event objects are deep-frozen, timestamps ties broken deterministically by input index, and input SHA-256 before and after record generation is bit-identical across 100 permutations.

name: explainability_completeness
template: Explainability completeness (FR4-FR7, NFR6) is verified: 100% of LOEO prediction records (95 technique, 76 tactic) validate against JSON Schema v1.0.0, contain candidate transition evidence and Wilson reliability banners, and render deterministically without UI computation.
